title: We all go right for the jugular with conversion ads, but it's killing...
description: We all go right for the jugular with conversion ads, but it's killing your scale. Lead forms, purchases, sales — those are all bottom-of-funnel objectives. In theory, we should all be running awareness or engagement campaigns first, then retargeting with conversion ads. Why? Because there are only so many people who want to buy a metal shed or a storage unit right this second. Once the algorithm runs out of that low-hanging fruit, it panics and your costs skyrocket. Feed the top of the funnel. Build the architecture. Stop relying entirely on demand capture. Save this to remind your media buyer. 📌 . . . #MarketingFunnel #FacebookAds #MediaBuying #EcommerceGrowth #DTCBrands #MarketingStrategy #AdAgency #ScalingEcom #DigitalMarketing #PerformanceMarketing #BusinessGrowth #EcomFounders #MarketingTips #GrowthHacking #AdOptimization
transcript: Technically, lead forms, purchases, sales, those are all bottom of funnel objectives and we all go right for the fucking jugular and then just change our creative types. We in theory should all be running awareness at a minimum or engagement then to an actual conversion based ad. But there's only so many people who follow to a conversion based ad who want a metal shed or storage unit right now. And the algorithm runs out of those people. It grabs those 99 low hanging fruit and then it's like, well, fuck it. I don't know. Why would we bump up the seasonal?
